summary: E11.7 authoring red-lines guard — pure-core classifyAuthoringOp + evaluateAuthoringRedLine (src/core/authoring-redlines.ts). Default-DENY principle: classifies AuthoringOp into non_destructive / destructive / core_pinned; evaluates verdict allow/deny with reason (requires_confirm / core_pinned / invalid_confirm). Semantic anti-autofill floor (AC-20) via isForbiddenTemplate (FORBIDDEN_SINGLE_WORDS + digit-only + repeated-char rules) — day-1 floor for T-0073 human-confirm surface. lossy_live_migration is core_pinned unconditionally (AC-19) — stricter than T-0177 isLossyNarrowing, enforces ADR §4 RED-LINES строки 154-155 categorical absolute (no escape-hatch, not even force+valid-confirm). Fitness check authoring-redlines-isolation.sh (ARL-1..6) + self-test. 51 unit tests (AC-2..AC-20). All CI gates green: tsc 0 errors, eslint 0 warnings, fitness all PASS, vitest 1612/1612 passed. semantic_notes.anti_autofill_floor: AC-20 isForbiddenTemplate enforces a semantic floor on consequenceStatement. The floor is intentionally UI/human-surface enforcement (T-0073 confirm surface), not a content-security check. Forbidden: single words (ok/да/yes/no/нет/confirm/подтверждаю/confirmed), digit-only sequences, repeated-char sequences. This is a day-1 floor; richer semantic validation (e.g. field-name presence check) belongs to the T-0073 UI surface, not this core pure function.
semantic_notes.core_pinned_absolute: lossy_live_migration is classified core_pinned regardless of isCorePinned context (AC-19). This is stricter than T-0177 isLossyNarrowing (which only elevates destructive→core_pinned for core-pinned fields). Rationale: ADR §4 RED-LINES строки 154-155 lists live-migration as categorical absolute alongside drop/rename of core fields — no escape-hatch permitted regardless of context. The distinction from T-0177 is deliberate and documented in the spec.
